cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of acceptance-criteria-builder (measurable-acceptance-table-builder) with contract handoff to blender-stop-condition-decider
cases.inputPrompt: Use acceptance-criteria-builder to turn our locked cyberpunk sneaker product-hero-v0 brief (16:9 PNG + web GLB under 10 MB) into a measurable Pass/Warn/Fail acceptance table before camera and lighting planning.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (locked_3d_brief) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces measurable_acceptance_criteria_table, pass_warn_fail_thresholds, evidence_hook_mappings for role measurable-acceptance-table-builder
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to blender-stop-condition-decider (Done / stop condition)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs measurable_acceptance_criteria_table, pass_warn_fail_thresholds, evidence_hook_mappings conforming to skills/acceptance-criteria-builder/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to blender-stop-condition-decider in skills/acceptance-criteria-builder/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete measurable_acceptance_criteria_table and hand off to blender-stop-condition-decider (Done / stop condition).
simulatedOutput.summary: Built measurable 7-row Pass/Warn/Fail acceptance criteria table with explicit verification methods and thresholds for product-hero-v0. Delivered Pass/Warn/Fail, verification method, measurable threshold and routed to blender-stop-condition-decider.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary upstream_reference contract handoff from acceptance-criteria-builder to intent-to-3d-brief-writer
cases.inputPrompt: While applying acceptance-criteria-builder, the workflow context is {"goal.clarity":"clear","brief.locked":false} (Brief source). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the upstream_reference handoff predicate in skills/acceptance-criteria-builder/contract.json
Routes to intent-to-3d-brief-writer (Brief source) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract upstream_reference handoff predicate match to intent-to-3d-brief-writer

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow upstream_reference handoff to intent-to-3d-brief-writer (Brief source).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered upstream_reference handoff from acceptance-criteria-builder to intent-to-3d-brief-writer under context {"goal.clarity":"clear","brief.locked":false}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in acceptance-criteria-builder
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during acceptance-criteria-builder with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for acceptance-criteria-builder and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for acceptance-criteria-builder.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (locked_3d_brief) for acceptance-criteria-builder halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Build an acceptance criteria table for our 3D project, even though we have not locked the 8-slot brief, target resolution, or consumer delivery format yet.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'locked_3d_brief' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing locked 8-slot brief and target delivery constraints required by acceptance-criteria-builder (locked_3d_brief)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: locked 8-slot brief and target delivery constraints
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'locked_3d_brief' (locked 8-slot brief and target delivery constraints)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing locked 8-slot brief and target delivery constraints (locked_3d_brief) before acceptance-criteria-builder locks measurable_acceptance_criteria_table.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted acceptance-criteria-builder due to missing required input 'locked_3d_brief' (locked 8-slot brief and target delivery constraints); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent locked 8-slot brief and target delivery constraints when 'locked_3d_brief' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (pure exploration without a locked deliverable) is excluded from acceptance-criteria-builder and delegated to blender-brainstorming
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of turn a locked 3d brief plus chosen recipe into a measurable acceptance checklist with evidence hooks., handle this request inside acceptance-criteria-builder: pure exploration without a locked deliverable.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/acceptance-criteria-builder/contract.json when pure exploration without a locked deliverable
Delegates to blender-brainstorming (use blender-brainstorming) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for acceptance-criteria-builder (pure exploration without a locked deliverable); delegate to blender-brainstorming.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced acceptance-criteria-builder exclusion boundary (use blender-brainstorming) and delegated to blender-brainstorming.
warnings: acceptance-criteria-builder is scoped to measurable-acceptance-table-builder and does not absorb blender-brainstorming responsibilities.
